source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash
source /ros_ws/install/setup.bash
export PYTHONPATH=/contrib/src:${PYTHONPATH:-}
mkdir -p /tmp/valdi_ros_ws/src
cp -r /contrib/ros2_lab_interfaces /tmp/valdi_ros_ws/src/oomwoo_cleaning_jobs_lab_interfaces
cd /tmp/valdi_ros_ws
colcon build --packages-select oomwoo_cleaning_jobs_lab_interfaces --parallel-workers 1 --event-handlers console_direct+ > /tmp/rosidl_build.log 2>&1 || { tail -n 40 /tmp/rosidl_build.log; exit 3; }
source /tmp/valdi_ros_ws/install/setup.bash
python3 /contrib/integration/ros_dock_velocity_relay_probe.py --three-way --keepout
